units: genre units (Source units), Godot axes; x metres = x * 0.01905

zones.comment: the one thing in the map that sends a player to heaven, and the only non-fail teleport on the main route

author: Kiiru
notes: Seven stages and four bonuses, all of which the map labels itself as startzone_s1..s7 and start/endzone_koga|sagan|spy|frag. The only thing missing is the main track's finish, because the map does not end in a zone: the end of stage 7 is a trigger_teleport into 'heaven', the reward room beside the spawn. That teleport is the finish line.
